<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
### Features
* Feat/aether UI redesign by @KYoiRyi in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/259
### Other Changes
* chore: update version to 1.0.5-alpha.1 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/237
* chore(deps-dev): bump the dev-dependencies group across 1 directory with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/224
* fix(krkr2): stabilize iPad rendering and restore gallery/text compatibility by @akitaSummer in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/249
* fix(android): handle system back gesture gracefully by @yorkyang2333 in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/238
* fix: null-guard SDL Android JNI calls for embedded Godot host by @yorkyang2333 in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/240
* ci: remove web build job and allow major actions updates in dependabot by @yorkyang2333 in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/208
* ci(submodules): set ignore = dirty for submodules by @yorkyang2333 in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/261
* fix: stabilize iOS emote and Siglus runtime integration by @akitaSummer in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/263
* fix(windows): build the production Godot extension by @KYoiRyi in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/258
* fix(catsystem2): restore scenario flow for Grisaia by @KYoiRyi in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/257
* Implementation of the Hxv4 Decoder and DripVM for Visual Novels with Hxv4 Encryption by @Walkedharmony in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/220

## New Contributors
* @Walkedharmony made their first contribution in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/220

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/compare/1.0.5-alpha.1...1.0.5-alpha.2
